Thick line: 95% interval. Thin line: Bonferroni interval for 20 contrasts. Both resample the scored months (4, or 3 where a month has no real event).'

text.font-family: Matter XH, DM Sans, sans-serif
text.tspan: Each combination minus the 50/50 mixture of the same lagged head and the lagless head
Left of the dashed line is better than 50/50. Dot: mean of month means.
Thick line: 95% interval. Thin line: Bonferroni interval for 20 contrasts.
Both resample the scored months (4, or 3 where a month has no real event).
